description: A fixture-seeded grocery search surface showing comparable product listings across multiple online storefronts.
notes: True search would require filtering results by query and ordering them by position; placement_type fixtures may label results as organic, promotional, or sponsored, and reference values are symbolic rather than live links.
source_request: A web/browser search results surface for comparison shopping across multiple online grocery storefronts: the agent can search for a product and get a results list spanning different stores (store name, product title, price, unit price, promo/sponsored flag, link-like reference), so scenarios can seed cross-store price comparisons, sponsored placements and dark patterns. Read-mostly; results are fixture-seeded, not live.
